title: Cardinality of the sample multiset
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, and choose any list of $m$ vectors in $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. The multiset formed by these samples, with repetitions counted, has cardinality $m$.
hypotheses_covered: the samples are any function assigning a vector in $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$ to each of the $m$ indices
